messages:
amanda: Quick sync — sharing the company-level OKR draft for the upcoming quarter. Link: https://redwood.internal/okrs/q3-draft Please do exec QA and flag any customer-driven asks that must be included.

raj: skimmed — main risk is latency SLO under Dedicated load. We should add a mitigation plan: autoscale buffer + canary.

sophie: UX ask from merchant beta — need a clearer rollout gating for embedded payments. If it's customer‑visible, add 'ops-ready' as launch criteria :eyes: \n
 darren: high level — product balance looks good. Two asks: 1) which customers force this to the top? 2) what is minimal scope to ship?

amanda: @claudia can you list priority customers pushing payments? add names and ARR impact.

claudia: Sure — AcmeCorp, Finzo, and BrightPay. Acme is the biggest: ~$1.2M ARR. All requested card-on-file + vaulted tokens.

jen: For measurement, we need an eval set for quality regressions + token-cost estimates. Put `perf / cost` as explicit sub-OKR.

raj: Proposal: break Payments Initiative into MEP (minimum embeddable product) + Post-MVP (fraud rules, reconciliation). MEP = tokenized card storage + token flow + basic UI.

amanda: I like that. Let's add launch gating checklist to the OKR doc. Draft checklist:
```
- Security review signed off (Infosec)
- KMS keys in place
- E2E token flow tested in staging
- Metrics: <1% decline delta, latency p95 < 350ms
- Customer pilot for Acme live
- Rollout plan and rollback playbook
```

sophie: Suggest replacing "E2E token flow" with "payment UX flows validated with customers" and add accessibility check.

darren: Also add legal/regulatory signoff for EU customers. Can't ship vaulted tokens in some regions without DPA updates.

amanda: Noted. @raj can you estimate engineering effort for MEP vs Post-MVP and highlight any risky dependencies (HSM/KMS, PCI scope)?

raj: Rough numbers: MEP ~10 eng-weeks across infra+frontend; Post-MVP +8 weeks. Risk: KMS/HSM lead time (2–4 weeks) and a vendor contract.

claudia: Customer ask: can we slip standard audit/attestation to Post-MVP? Acme needs tokenization ASAP; they're willing to accept limited audit if contractually noted.

darren: Contract exceptions are risky but acceptable with legal guardrails. @amanda work with legal to scope the limited attestation and add to rollout conditions.

deploy-bot: Deploy OKR doc revision committed by amanda at 1719999000

amanda: Action items:
- me: update OKR doc with MEP vs Post-MVP and checklist (by EOD)
- raj: add eng estimates + call out KMS/HSM vendor lead time (tomorrow)
- claudia: share customer priority list and contacts (tomorrow)
- jen: define perf/cost metrics and eval plan (Friday)
- sophie: add UX validation criteria + accessibility check (Friday)
- darren: confirm EU legal constraints with Legal (Monday)

darren: If we get the above, I can sign off on the slate on Monday. :+1:

amanda: Thanks all — please react with :white_check_mark: once you've completed your action and I'll lock the OKR after Monday's check-in.
